signals.name: external_reference_exact
signals.description: Exact match on client_case_ref or provider_case_ref when the reference is not flagged as stale or reused

signals.name: customer_name_similarity
signals.description: Normalized customer or account name similarity, including punctuation and suffix normalization

signals.name: site_address_match
signals.description: Normalized site address match using street-type and suite normalization

signals.name: asset_identifier_match
signals.description: Exact or near-exact asset serial, controller, unit, or equipment identifier match

signals.name: contact_match
signals.description: Matching primary contact email or phone

signals.name: historical_activity_support
signals.description: Activity log or note evidence that ties the inbound packet to a specific record

signals.name: provider_alias_alignment
signals.description: Provider names that map through approved aliases or migration relationships

negative_signals.name: reference_reuse_warning
negative_signals.description: Subtract when a reference is explicitly flagged as stale, reused, or copied forward incorrectly

negative_signals.name: asset_type_conflict
negative_signals.description: Subtract when the inbound asset category conflicts with the candidate record's asset category

negative_signals.name: closed_record_without_reopen_evidence
negative_signals.description: Subtract when a record is closed and there is no evidence it should be resumed

update.description: Use when the inbound packet clearly refers to an existing record under the same operating provider family and no meaningful ambiguity remains

transfer.description: Use when the inbound packet clearly refers to an existing record but operational ownership has moved to a different provider or provider family

new_record.description: Use when no existing record remains credible after applying positive and negative signals

duplicate_review.description: Use when two or more records remain plausible after applying policy and a reviewer must resolve the ambiguity
